messages:
maya: customer reported intermittent stream drops for long generations (~40s gaps between tokens). They see a final partial output and then connection closed by peer. Happens on our hosted API via their EU region proxy. Logs from their side show a TCP FIN from upstream. 

kevin: customer affected: acme-ml. They say it started after they enabled a safety prompt that causes longer thinking. They sent a pcap — attaching summary. Billing flagged duplicate partial charges when client reconnects.

maya: copying in eng-runtime (jonah) and eng-sre (li). key bits from the pcap they provided: 
```
# tcpdump -n -r acme_stream.pcap
12:01:14.123456 IP client->edge 10.0.0.1:52344 > 34.56.78.90:443: Flags [P.], seq 123:567, ack 890, win 65535
12:01:54.987654 IP edge->client 34.56.78.90:443 > 10.0.0.1:52344: Flags [F.], seq 890, ack 567, win 65535
# FIN sent from edge after ~40s of no data
```

li: that looks like the L7 balancer/proxy tearing the connection due to idle timeout. Our runtime continues generating but intermediate proxy closes socket. We usually send periodic SSE comments to keep proxies alive, but looks like model pauses > idle window. Which proxy is in front?

kevin: acme-ml's network team says they're using FastProxy v2 with default idle 30s in front of our edge.

jonah: ok. Repro steps I used locally against a long-generating prompt: 
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \ 
  "https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams?model=open-llama-20b" \ 
  --data-binary @prompt.txt
```
With a prompt that causes ~45s pauses between token chunks, after ~30s proxy sends FIN and client sees: 
```
event: closed\ndata: {"error":"connection reset by peer"}
```

jonah: Observability notes: runtime logs for the trace show generation continued server-side past the FIN (we still emitted tokens into the stream buffer). Trace id: trace-0a1b2c3d. Edge logs show connection closed with reason IDLE_TIMEOUT. No 5xx from runtime.

sara: customer-facing quick mitigation: ask them to bump FastProxy idle timeout to >= 90s or enable keepalive. Also add client-side keepalive/heartbeat to the SDK: send a comment line `:\n` every 15s (SSE comment) while waiting for tokens. That will keep most proxies from closing.

maya: billing issue — they reported double-charge for the overlapped tokens when client reconnected and received final chunk twice. Is there server-side dedupe by request id?

jonah: currently we do not dedupe at token billing boundary for resumed connections. For resumable sessions we rely on resume token semantics: if client reconnects with the same resume_id and offset, we should avoid double-counting. In this case the client retried as a fresh stream (no resume_id) so the runtime billed both partial and resumed completions.

li: short-term: support can offer credit for the duplicate consumption (we should reconcile per-customer). Long-term: add enforcement to require resume_id for retries or tag retried requests with original-session-id to dedupe billing. I'll file an infra ticket.

kevin: customer wants a reproducible script we can give them. Here's a minimal repro they can run (we tested it): 
```
# simulate long pause tokens
cat > prompt.txt <<'PROMPT'
<system>Slow-thinking test</system>
User: generate a long analytical chain with 200 tokens but pause 35s after 2nd sentence.
PROMPT

curl -v -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d @prompt.txt "https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams?model=open-llama-20b"
```
Watch for FIN from proxy in `tcpdump -n port 443` output.

pcap-bot: uploaded acme_stream.pcap to /support/attachments/1918765432-acme_stream.pcap (md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e).

jonah: proposed runtime mitigation: emit automated idle-heartbeat comments every 20s for streams with active generation but no tokens emitted for >15s. Example SSE chunk: `: keepalive\n\n` — this is small and ignored by clients but keeps proxies from closing. We'll roll this as config flag behind feature gate.

sara: also add client SDK feature: `streaming.keepaliveIntervalMs=15000` default off for backwards compat. Docs update to recommend enabling when behind proxies with short idle timeouts.

li: network fix: recommend edge/proxy teams set `timeout_idle` >= 120s for RL/LLM streaming use case. If tenant cannot change, our keepalive will cover most cases.

jonah: patch in staging: runtime now emits comment heartbeats and sets a `x-resume-token` header sooner. Patch PR: https://git.redwood/rdw/inference/pull/4587 (staging only). We'll monitor for error spikes.

maya: support action items: 1) Offer acme-ml a credit for duplicate tokens (kevin) 2) Share repro script & ask customer to increase proxy timeout or enable SDK keepalive (sara) 3) Track infra ticket for billing dedupe (li) 4) Deploy runtime keepalive to hosted EU region canary (jonah).

kevin: acme-ml accepted the credits if we provide a short technical note to their infra team. I'll draft.

maya: thanks all. tagging owners on each item. I'll follow up in 48h with status. :thumbsup:
